The '''J-type''' was a type of [[Engine/Legends|twin-engine]] design used by [[Nubia Star Drives, Incorporated/Legends|Nubian]] in several [[Starship/Legends|starships]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|176|J-type}}</ref>
